chemistry-h3-c.material: [Colligative properties mai zurfi] Waɗanne daga cikin kalamai masu zuwa game da halayen (colligative properties) na maganin dilute mai ɗauke da solute marar tafiya da non-electrolyte daidai ne? chemistry-killer-12.material: A 25 °C, $\mathrm{p}K_a$ na acetic acid ($\mathrm{CH_3COOH}$) shi ne 4.7. An haɗa 100 mL na 0.20 M $\mathrm{CH_3COOH}$ da 100 mL na 0.10 M $\mathrm{CH_3COONa}$ aka samar da buffer. Menene pH na maganin idan aka ƙara 10 mL na 1.0 M $\mathrm{NaOH(aq)}$? (Canjin ƙarfi saboda canjin girma ba ya shafar lissafin rabo, kuma yi amfani da $\log 2 = 0.30$. Lokacin haɗawa NaOH yana amsawa gaba ɗaya da acetic acid.)
chemistry-killer-12.s.s1.prompt: A 25 °C, $\mathrm{p}K_a$ na acetic acid ($\mathrm{CH_3COOH}$) shi ne 4.7. An haɗa 100 mL na 0.20 M $\mathrm{CH_3COOH}$ da 100 mL na 0.10 M $\mathrm{CH_3COONa}$ aka samar da buffer. Menene pH na maganin idan aka ƙara 10 mL na 1.0 M $\mathrm{NaOH(aq)}$? (Canjin ƙarfi saboda canjin girma ba ya shafar lissafin rabo, kuma yi amfani da $\log 2 = 0.30$. Lokacin haɗawa NaOH yana amsawa gaba ɗaya da acetic acid.)
chemistry-killer-12.s.s1.explain:
Mataki na 1: Mole na farko. HA = 20 mmol, A⁻ = 10 mmol (pH na farko = 4.7 + log 0.5 = 4.7 − 0.30 = 4.4).
Mataki na 2: NaOH 1.0 M × 10 mL = 10 mmol → a amsawar $\mathrm{OH^- + HA \rightarrow A^- + H_2O}$ HA yana raguwa da 10 mmol, A⁻ yana ƙaruwa da 10 mmol. HA = 10 mmol, A⁻ = 20 mmol.
Mataki na 3: Tunda magani ɗaya ne, rabon ƙarfi = rabon mole = 2. pH = 4.7 + log 2 = 4.7 + 0.30 = 5.0.
Amsa: 5.0 (d). (Kuskure: 4.4 shi ne pH kafin ƙara NaOH, 4.7 ana samunsa ta kuskuren lissafin HA da A⁻ daidai suke, 5.3 ƙima ce ta rabon 4)
